4. Report: last inbound from John, last outbound from us, whether there is an unanswered new reply. Do not send any message. Do not print the full phone number.

Do not type credentials.
I'll start by taking a screenshot to see the current desktop state.

content.text: It seems there's no incognito window open, so I'll use Ctrl+Shift+N to open one.

Stopping per instructions — the session is not paired.

**Result: UNPAIRED — no conversations available.**

- No pre-existing Incognito window was present, so I opened a fresh Incognito window (Ctrl+Shift+N) and navigated to https://messages.google.com/web/u/0/conversations
- It redirected to `messages.google.com/web/welcome?redirectUrl=%2Fconversations`, showing "Welcome to Google Messages" with **Sign In** and **Pair with QR code** — no conversation list at all.
- Because Incognito discards cookies/site data on close, the previous pairing did not persist; the John Jensen thread could not be opened.
- Per the stop condition, I did not sign in, did not pair, entered no credentials, and sent no messages.

To proceed, a human needs to pair the phone (scan the QR code at messages.google.com in this Incognito window) — or the thread should be opened in a normal (non-Incognito) Chrome profile where the pairing persists.
